, starring and , is a Netflix investigative thriller about two journalists who uncover an illegal sand-mining mafia while investigating a fatal incident. But can this story about journalism, corruption and the pursuit of truth deliver the suspense it promises?
In this episode of Firstpost Presents: First Cut, Dabeet Singh reviews and analyses Reporting Live, breaking down the performances, writing, direction, investigation, suspense and everything that works and doesn't.
